sub_tasks.desc: Coder Agent: Create DDL file for courses table with schema: CREATE TABLE courses (id UUID PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT, instructor_id UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP); Include indexes on instructor_id and created_at.

Coder Agent: Create CourseList.js component that fetches data from GET /courses API endpoint (expects response: { courses: [{ id: string, title: string, description: string, instructor_id: string, created_at: string, updated_at: string }] }) and renders a list with course title, description, and instructor details. Implement error handling for failed requests.

Coder Agent: Create NotificationHandler.js component that listens for push notifications (FCM/APNs) and displays toast notifications. Handle payload structure: { title: string, body: string, type: string }. Implement event listeners for message events and error handling.

Coder Agent: Integrate CourseList component into CoursesPage.js, fetch courses data from GET /courses API on component mount, handle loading and error states, and render the course list. Ensure proper state management and useEffect cleanup.

Coder Agent: Integrate NotificationHandler component into NotificationPage.js, set up push notification listener, and display toast notifications for incoming messages. Handle notification click events and navigation.

Reviewer Agent: Perform OWASP security review for XSS (sanitize user inputs, use React dangerouslySetInnerHTML cautiously), CSRF (implement CSRF tokens for state-changing requests), CSP (define Content-Security-Policy headers), and token management (secure storage and transmission of auth tokens).

Tester Agent: Write unit tests for CourseList.js: mock API call, test rendering of course list, error handling. For NotificationHandler.js: mock push notification events, test toast display. Use Jest and React Testing Library.
Tester Agent: Write integration test for CoursesPage.js: simulate user navigation, API data fetching, and course list rendering. Test interaction with CourseList component and error scenarios.

Reviewer Agent: Perform static code analysis on entire frontend/web directory using ESLint and custom rules for security, syntax, and code style compliance. Check for common vulnerabilities and code smells.
Doc Agent: Compile technical documentation including setup instructions, component APIs, security guidelines, and testing procedures for the frontend web module.
